reasons: Deviation is correctly identified: original 22.1 permits audits 'at any time without notice' plus remote system access, which is expressly the playbook walk-away position.

Redline reaches the preferred position in full — once per 12 months, 30 days' prior written notice, business hours, off-site where feasible, independent auditor under confidentiality, and no direct or remote system access — and adds a records-based satisfaction mechanic consistent with 'off-site where possible'.

Omitting cost allocation from 22.1 is correct rather than incomplete: 22.2 already allocates audit cost to Vendor unless underpayment exceeds five percent, matching the preferred threshold, so no edit was needed there.

The high changed-character ratio (0.801) is justified: the original sentence's entire operative content (unlimited, unannounced, remote-access audit) had to be replaced; no smaller edit could remove the walk-away terms.
Comment is accurate, concise, in first person plural, cites the playbook position, notes the alignment with the already-agreed 22.2 access limits, and offers the 15-day notice fallback.
